text:
Marta: Heads up — starting bring-up for q6b-int4 (RAG workloads). Need to sync on promptset de-dupe + golden updates. Target rollout window Tue morning. /cc @Jamie @Nora @Aj
Jamie: Can do. How many golden samples need regen? Any new deid constraints?
Marta: Estimate ~1.2k golden examples across longform and QA. New de-id rule: strip emails + tokens that look like SSN. See patch in curation repo.
Aj: Labeler capacity looks tight Tue. We can prioritize microgolden first (200) then stagger rest. Also need new labeling instructions for int4 hallucination checks.
Sam: On eval side I'll run A/B against q4b baseline. Plan: run eval-harness with these flags:
```bash
python run_eval.py --model q6b-int4 --baseline q4b --metrics perplexity,em_score,answer_accuracy --sample-set s3://redwood/holdouts/q6b_canary.json
```
Lee: De-dupe note: tokenizer changes in int4 conversion shifted hashes — run fuzzy-match with Jaccard>=0.8. Will push script.
Marta: OK. Action items: 1) Jamie: draft labeling brief 2) Lee: de-dupe run + PR 3) Sam: eval A/B + smoke 4) Aj: labeler schedule. Aim to freeze golden by Mon EOD.
Jamie: Draft done, uploaded to google doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Added checklists for hallucination templates and expected label distribution.
Nora: QA will run sample-level regression checks and sanity diff to previous golden. Will need embeddings recall pass — @Sam can you include embed comparisons?
Sam: yes will include embeddings recall and rerank BLEU. Also I will export failure cases into /tmp/q6b_failures.csv for curation.
Lee: Pushed de-dupe job: `spark-submit --class com.redwood.dedupe --conf spark.executor.memory=8g s3://scripts/dedupe.jar --input s3://banks/merged --out s3://banks/q6b_dedupe` Results: 1.8% overlap with existing bank, 120 collisions flagged. PR: #438
Jamie: Good — we'll pull collisions into special review queue. How to label collisions? binary keep/delete?
Marta: Use binary keep/delete + reason tag. For near-duplicates keep as 'variant' only if prompt diverges > 3 tokens. Jamie to update rubric.
Aj: Ops: labeler team can do microgolden Tue AM (200). For rest, need 48h runway. Also request for overtime? probably fine.
deploy-bot: New canary cluster q6b-int4 deployed to canary-us-west-2. Instances: 6 GPUs. Health: 6/6
Nora: After microgolden I'll run regression snapshot and diff. Please don't merge golden until I ack.
Marta: Noted. If all green, schedule canary traffic shift 5% Wed 09:00 PT.
Jamie: Labeling doc update: added sample checklist + QA filters. Link: https://docs.google.com/example2
Sam: Quick note — quantization changed tokenizer offsets causing some eval misalignments. I added a converter in eval harness: `tools/token_offset_fix.py`
Lee: Also found 3k prompts with trailing nulls that cause model chokes. Cleaning job in progress (ETA 2h).
Marta: Thanks all. Keeping thread for status. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:

Aj: Microgolden done, uploaded labels to s3://redwood/labels/q6b/microgolden_2026-03-30.csv
Nora: QA snapshot shows 0.9% accuracy drop vs baseline on open QA, but hallucination delta within tolerance. Approve golden freeze pending 1 more run.
Marta: I'll coordinate final run. Meeting 08:30 Mon to finalize.
Jamie: One more note — collisions review cadence: 2 reviewers per item, aim 24h turnaround for the flagged 120. Putting tasks into the review board now.
Lee: De-dupe PR merged, but left 12 ambiguous clusters for manual review.
Sam: Final A/B run queued. Will post artifacts: s3://redwood/evals/q6b/ab_run_1745.tar.gz and failure CSV.
Marta: If final run matches microgolden signoff, proceed with 5% canary Wed. If not, rollback to q4b and triage.
Nora: Copy. Will post final QA delta here.
Marta: Thanks everyone — nice quick turn.
